# Halftone

Print-style halftone screens: four rotated CMYK screens, a single ink, or additive RGB, drawn as dots, lines or squares sized by the tone under each cell.

<EffectDemo effect="halftone" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { halftone } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/halftone';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(halftone({ preset: 'newsprint' }));
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.mode = 'cmyk'`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter  | Type                        | Default     | Range       | Description                                                                     |
| ---------- | --------------------------- | ----------- | ----------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `mode`     | 'cmyk' \| 'mono' \| 'rgb'   | `'cmyk'`    |             | Four subtractive screens, one ink on paper, or three additive screens on black. |
| `shape`    | 'dot' \| 'line' \| 'square' | `'dot'`     |             | Shape of each screen element.                                                   |
| `scale`    | number                      | `8`         | 2 – 48 px   | Screen period: the distance between neighbouring elements.                      |
| `angle`    | number                      | `0`         | -90 – 90 °  | Rotates every screen. CMYK screens keep their 15°, 75°, 0° and 45° offsets.     |
| `softness` | number                      | `1`         | 0.25 – 4 px | Width of the antialiased edge.                                                  |
| `ink`      | hex color                   | `'#1a1a1a'` |             | Mono: ink color.                                                                |
| `paper`    | hex color                   | `'#f4efe4'` |             | Paper color for CMYK and mono.                                                  |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset      | Settings                                                 |
| ----------- | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| `newsprint` | `mode: 'mono'`, `scale: 6`, `angle: 45`                  |
| `comic`     | `mode: 'cmyk'`, `scale: 12`                              |
| `lines`     | `mode: 'mono'`, `shape: 'line'`, `scale: 7`, `angle: 30` |
| `screen`    | `mode: 'rgb'`, `shape: 'square'`, `scale: 5`             |

Apply one with `halftone({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Retro & display · tracked as story X8.2 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** samples the pass input at other positions, so it starts a new merged pass; following pixel effects join that pass.
- **Masks:** set `effect.mask` to a texture, depth range or selection to limit where it applies; see [masks](/guide/masks).
- **Motion:** Static: nothing animates.
- **Size:** 7.1 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/halftone`, including the shared effect runtime.

## Credits

Original implementation (MIT). References: Traditional CMYK screen angles (C 15°, M 75°, Y 0°, K 45°) with area-proportional dots.

## Related

- [Dither](./dither) — Reduces each channel to a few levels and hides the banding with a dither pattern: ordered Bayer matrices, void-and-cluster blue noise, or interleaved gradient noise.
- [Pixelate](./pixelate) — Big square, hexagonal or round pixels, each the color at its center.
- [ASCII](./ascii) — Redraws the image as text: each cell becomes the character whose ink matches its brightness, in the original colors or in two theme colors.
